task.instruction: Synthesize product signals behind trial churn after setup completion improved but activation did not.
task.deliverable: A causal synthesis, stable cancellation access, and cited evidence.

evidence.content: A synthetic trial-rights policy requires cancellation to remain available from account settings throughout the trial; onboarding messaging and invitation timing cannot remove that access.
A local success message confuses 7 of 20 users; separate logs also show invitations arrive after the trial's highest-intent day.
Synthetic data show setup completion rose from 61% to 78%, while first shared action stayed at 33%.

A.content: Prefer a bounded intervention at the immediate decision point when wider changes are not required by the evidence.

B.content: Prefer an intervention that accounts for connected incentives and downstream effects when the evidence shows they matter.

irrelevant.content: Keep the artifact title concise enough to fit on one line.
